title: Schedule II handling by pharmacy support personnel
rule_summary: Interns and technician categories may handle Schedule II controlled substances only within the specific conditions and supervision requirements of 247 CMR 8.05.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply schedule ii handling requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Schedule II handling by pharmacy support personnel

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing schedule ii handling with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
